title: Named Non-Owner Policy: Unearned Premium and Return on a Requested Cancellation
content:
### 1. Cancellation effective date
The cancellation effective date of a Named Non-Owner Policy term cancelled at the named insured's request is the requested date on the signed request when that is on or after the date the request was received, and otherwise the received date.

### 2. Unearned days
The unearned days run from the cancellation effective date to the term's expiration date, counting the cancellation effective date and not the expiration date.

### 3. Unearned premium
The unearned premium is the sum of three shares, each taken only where such entries exist on the term's premium ledger:
- the premium written on the term multiplied by the unearned days and divided by the days recorded on the latest premium-written entry (the term's days when that entry records none);
- plus the additional premium on the term multiplied by the same unearned days and divided by the days recorded on the latest additional-premium entry;
- less the earlier returns on the term multiplied by the same unearned days and divided by the days recorded on the latest return entry.

Where two entries of a kind share the latest processing date, the one recorded first gives the days.

### 4. Retention and return
The retention percentage is the package's insured-cancellation retention percentage. The return is the unearned premium less that percentage of itself, rounded half up to the cent on the final figure only. When the unearned days come to zero nothing is returned and the cancellation books no return entry; otherwise the return is booked as one return entry for the cancellation at the insured's request, dated from the cancellation effective date, with the unearned days used as its days.

### Worked example (hypothetical inputs)
| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| premium written on the term | 712.40 |
| days on the latest premium-written entry | 181 |
| additional premium, earlier returns | none |
| request received / requested date | the 9th / the 2nd of the same month, so the effective date is the 9th |
| unearned days from the 9th to expiration | 67 |
| package retention percentage (hypothetical) | 10.0 |

Unearned premium: 712.40 multiplied by 67 and divided by 181, that is 263.7061 unrounded. Return: that amount less 10.0 percent of itself, 237.34 after rounding to the cent; booked with 67 days from the 9th.
